title: Humour House — Comedy Club of IIT Kanpur
description: Founded the official comedy club of IIT Kanpur and got it formally approved under the Students' Gymkhana. Performed, trained comedians, and organized year-round campus open mics, standup workshops, and roasts.

title: IITK Meme Hub & Viral Content Creation
description: Built and scaled the viral IITK Meme Hub community across Instagram and Facebook during first year of college. When a professor gave the option to submit an assignment or memes, I opened the email at 2 AM, created 20 memes in 30 minutes, submitted them, and got featured in the professor's LinkedIn post.

title: Viral YouTube Video (138k+ Views)
description: Created and published a viral video that organically crossed 138,000+ views on YouTube.
